title: Meri Gemini Candidate Knowledge Extraction Schema
description: Versioned JSON contract for Gemini structured knowledge candidate extraction from long-form business podcast transcripts.

episode_summary.description: Structured executive summaries of the episode discussion.

brief.description: Concise 1-2 sentence high-level summary suitable for cards and mobile previews.

comprehensive.description: In-depth multi-paragraph synthesis of the conversation, market context, and business thesis.

primary_themes.description: Core business themes discussed during the interview.

guest_profile.description: Candidate guest profile extracted from conversational context and episode introductions.

name.description: Full name of the interviewed entrepreneur or business executive.

company.description: Primary enterprise or organization founded or led by the guest.

bio.description: Editorial biography summarizing prior background, achievements, and technical expertise.

industry.description: Primary business sector (e.g. 'Agricultural Logistics & Cold Storage', 'Fintech').

journey_summary.description: Optional summary of how the founder started, pivoted, and scaled the enterprise.

journey_milestones.description: Chronological business milestones explicitly supported by interview transcript evidence.

phase_or_year.description: Year, time range, or company phase (e.g. '2019 - Seed Stage', 'Year 3').

milestone_description.description: Description of the operational or market milestone achieved.

strategic_decision.description: Key strategic choice or pivot made during this milestone.

evidence_segment_indices.description: Strict references to transcript segment indices corroborating this milestone.

insights.description: Structured entrepreneurial lessons, strategic frameworks, and practical takeaways.

title.description: Concise, compelling takeaway title summarizing the strategic lesson.

summary.description: Comprehensive explanation of the insight and underlying rationale.

takeaways.description: Bullet-point takeaways detailing actionable business mechanics.

practical_action.description: Concrete directive an entrepreneur or operator can implement immediately.

evidence_segment_indices.description: Exact zero-based transcript segment indices validating every claim made in this insight.

confidence_score.description: Model self-assessed confidence in the factual grounding of this extraction.

quotations.description: High-signal spoken quotes captured in original Amharic with verified English translations.

amharic_quote.description: Exact or near-verbatim Amharic quote spoken by the guest.

english_translation.description: High-fidelity English translation preserving nuance and business idioms.

speaker.description: Name of the speaker who uttered the quote.

source_segment_index.description: Index of the specific transcript segment where this quote begins.

timestamp_seconds.description: Absolute elapsed start time in seconds, derived strictly from source_segment_index start_ms / 1000. Never invented.

context.description: Conversational context and surrounding topic when the speaker made this statement.

importance_rationale.description: Editorial rationale explaining why this quote holds high lasting value.

suggested_tags.description: Searchable topic tags for indexing and discovery.
